title: Hot Molten Polish Almond Pudding
description: A tangy and energizing Polish dessert featuring almond essence, made with a bain-marie for a molten center, and is keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, erythritol, and lemon zest.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond milk, almond extract, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted butter and whisk until fully incorporated.
Add the egg yolks one at a time, whisking until fully incorporated after each addition.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the egg whites into the almond mixture until no white streaks remain.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins and place in a large baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
